tools.name: get_page_info
tools.description: Get the current target page URL, title, and meta description

tools.name: get_page_html
tools.description: EXPENSIVE — last-resort tool that returns the full page outerHTML (up to 512 KiB) and balloons the context. Do NOT call this to summarize a page, find a link/button, or "see what is on the page" — the <current-webpage> markdown block already attached to the user message answers those, and get_accessibility_tree is far cheaper for interactive structure. Only use when you specifically need raw markup the other tools cannot give you (e.g. reading an inline __NEXT_DATA__ / JSON-LD script, or inspecting <meta>/<head> attributes Readability strips). Prefer a targeted execute_script that returns only the substring you need over downloading the whole document.

tools.name: get_accessibility_tree
tools.description: Get a semantic accessibility tree of the current page. Use this before interacting with page elements. Pass the returned document_id, snapshot_id, and ref_id to click_by_ref for a guarded interaction.

filter.description: Filter mode: "interactive" (only clickable/input elements, default), "visible" (viewport only), "all" (full page)

tools.name: query_elements
tools.description: Query a compact set of page elements by scope and semantic filters. Returns document_id, snapshot_id, and stable ref_ids for guarded click_by_ref calls. A scope ref_id must include the document_id and snapshot_id returned with that ref.

scope.description: Optional search root selected by CSS selector, prior ref_id, or semantic role/name; use nth or index to disambiguate. A ref_id scope also requires its source document_id and snapshot_id.

document_id.description: The document_id returned with the scope ref_id.

snapshot_id.description: The snapshot_id returned with the scope ref_id.

text_match.description: Text matching mode; defaults to exact.

max_results.description: Maximum matches to return; defaults to 20 and is capped at 100.

require_count.description: Fail unless the total match count equals this value.

tools.name: resolve_element_context
tools.description: Resolve one reusable element selected by the user on the current page. When multiple element chips are selected, pass context_id or index. Returns a temporary selector for that element, usually [data-dao-element-context="current"].

index.description: Zero-based index from the resolver error contexts list.

label.description: Element label to resolve when context_id is unavailable.

tools.name: capture_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of the current page viewport. Returns the screenshot as a base64-encoded image for visual analysis.

tools.name: click_element
tools.description: Click an element on the current page by CSS selector

selector.description: CSS selector of the element to click

tools.name: agent_click
tools.description: Click an element with visual cursor animation. Shows a purple pointer moving to the element, highlights it, and performs the click. Use this instead of click_element when the tab is being controlled by the agent.

selector.description: CSS selector of the element to click

description.description: Human-readable description of the action (e.g. "Click the Submit button")

tools.name: click_by_ref
tools.description: Atomically validate and click an element by ref_id. The required document and snapshot ids prevent stale-page clicks; optional preconditions guard semantic context.

ref_id.description: The ref_id from the accessibility tree (e.g. "ref_3")

document_id.description: The document_id returned with the ref_id.

snapshot_id.description: The snapshot_id returned with the ref_id.

description.description: Human-readable description of the click action

tools.name: move_cursor
tools.description: Move the visual cursor to viewport coordinates without clicking

tools.name: highlight_element
tools.description: Highlight an element on the page with a purple border overlay

selector.description: CSS selector of the element to highlight

tools.name: scroll_down
tools.description: Scroll down the page. Defaults to ~80% of viewport height. Optionally specify exact pixel amount.

amount.description: Scroll amount in pixels. Omit to scroll by ~80% of viewport height.

tools.name: scroll_up
tools.description: Scroll up the page. Defaults to ~80% of viewport height. Optionally specify exact pixel amount.

amount.description: Scroll amount in pixels. Omit to scroll by ~80% of viewport height.

tools.name: scroll_to_element
tools.description: Scroll a specific element into view. Accepts either a CSS selector or a ref_id from the accessibility tree.

tools.name: press_key_chord
tools.description: Simulate a keyboard shortcut (e.g. "ctrl+a", "cmd+c", "Enter", "Tab", "Escape", "Backspace"). Dispatches keydown/keyup events on the focused element.

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Type text into the currently focused input field character by character using CDP Input.insertText. Works with all input types including contentEditable and shadow DOM inputs.

text.description: The text to type into the focused element

clear.description: If true, select all and replace existing content before typing. Default: false (append).

tools.name: execute_script
tools.description: Execute JavaScript code on the current page and return the result

lock_tab.description: Whether to temporarily lock the current tab while this script manipulates the page. Use false for read-only scripts.

tools.name: list_tabs
tools.description: List tabs in the authorized browser window with stable tab ids, current indices, URLs, titles, and active status.

tools.name: switch_tab
tools.description: Switch to a browser tab in the authorized window by stable tab id or current index. Use only for explicit browser-tab navigation, not for page-local tabs, links, buttons, or menu items.

tab_id.description: Stable tab id from list_tabs; takes precedence over index

tools.name: open_tab
tools.description: Open a new browser tab with the given URL.

tools.name: close_tab
tools.description: Close a browser tab in the authorized window by stable tab id or current index. Defaults to the pinned target tab.

tab_id.description: Stable tab id from list_tabs; takes precedence over index

index.description: Tab index to close (defaults to the pinned target tab)

tools.name: enable_network_tracking
tools.description: Start capturing network requests on the current tab and return the current cursor for later wait_for_network_response calls.

tools.name: get_network_requests
tools.description: Get the bounded recent network request buffer (URLs, methods, status codes) plus next_cursor, stored_bytes, dropped_count, and truncated_field_count metadata. Must call enable_network_tracking first.

tools.name: wait_for_network_response
tools.description: Wait for a completed response after a cursor, match URL/method/status and an optional JSON value, then return only selected JSON paths.

cursor.description: Cursor returned by enable_network_tracking or a previous network result; defaults to 0.

select.description: Simple JSON paths to return instead of the full body.

timeout_ms.description: Wait timeout in milliseconds; defaults to 30000 and is capped at 180000.

tools.name: clear_network_requests
tools.description: Clear all captured network requests.

tools.name: get_network_body
tools.description: Fetch the response body of a captured network request by request_id (from get_network_requests). Requires enable_network_tracking to have run before the request was made.

request_id.description: The CDP request id from get_network_requests.

tools.name: enable_console_tracking
tools.description: Start capturing console messages (logs, warnings, errors) on the current tab.

tools.name: get_console_messages
tools.description: Get the bounded recent console message buffer plus stored_bytes, dropped_count, and truncated_field_count metadata. Optionally filter by type. Must call enable_console_tracking first.

filter.description: Filter by message type: "error", "warning", "log", "info". Omit for all.

tools.name: clear_console_messages
tools.description: Clear all captured console messages.

tools.name: list_page_resources
tools.description: List bounded, deduplicated resources for the current page and its frames, including one synthesized Document per frame. Returns resources plus processed, eligible, skipped, and resource_limit_hit metadata.

tools.name: get_resource_content
tools.description: Fetch one resource by exact URL. Decoded resources are limited to 1 MiB; accepted text is returned with UTF-8-safe truncation at 512 KiB and accepted binary is exact base64.

url.description: The resource URL (exact match, from list_page_resources).

frame_id.description: Optional frame id. When omitted, resolve the resource by exact URL across the current frame tree; when supplied, require that exact frame and URL pair.

tools.name: search_in_resources
tools.description: Regex-search bounded loaded text resources. Returns hits with {url, frame_id, line, excerpt}; attempted, searched, fetch_failed, and content_limit_failures counts; and explicit incomplete, source, scan, match, and resource-limit metadata.

pattern.description: Regex pattern (RE2 syntax; lookaround and backreferences are unsupported).

flags.description: Regex flags: only "i" (case-insensitive) is supported. Defaults to "i".

types.description: Comma-separated resource types to search (default: "Script,Stylesheet,Document"). Binary types (Image, Font) are always skipped.
